Name: Better Rods
Author: Achtuur8
Description:
[b][size=5]Overview[/size][/b]

Were you under the impression that buying a fishing rod makes fishing easier? Well, that's actually wrong! Higher tier fishing rods only give you the ability to use bait, and eventually a tackle. This mod aims to make upgrading your fishing rod feel more satisfying by making them actual better rods.


[b][size=5]Features
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Makes higher tier fishing rods (Fiberglass, Iridium) better at the fishing minigame:[list]
[*][b]Faster nibble time[/b], giving you faster bites.
[*][b]Faster fishing bar[/b], making control slightly harder to stabilise, but helps catching up with faster fish
[*][b]Faster catching[/b], the catch bar (on the right of the fishing minigame) increases faster when your bar is on a fish
[*][b]Slower loss[/b], the catch bar (on the right of the fishing minigame) decreases slower when your bar is not on the fish
[/list]
[*]Highly configurable:[list]
[*]Every setting can be globally turned on/off[list]
[*]Don't want faster fishing bar? Simply turn it off!
[/list]
[*]Every setting above is configurable per fishing rod.
[*]Recommendatons:[list]
[*]Don't increase bar speed [i]too [/i]high/low, as this makes it harder to control.
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Balanced for vanilla (by default):[list]
[*]Nibble times are 5% faster for fiberglass rod, and 10% faster for iridium rod.
[*]Bamboo pole and training rod are slightly nerfed (0.9x effective)
[*]Fiberglass is the same as a vanilla rod (1x effective)
[*]Iridium rod is slightly better (1.1x effective)
[/list]
[/list]
